method_summary: three roles: constrain, rank, commit. Multiword senses compete as ordinary candidates.

gloss.note: worth about +11pp on hard words, not the ~2pp an easier panel implies

multiword.note: never a veto: only 9% of hits map onto an existing leaf and about a quarter are compositional, where a veto would delete the correct answer

commit.note: gloss backoff validated at 78%->85% on a hard panel; the tuple trigger is NOT validated -- the tuple margin proved non-monotonic against tuple correctness. Do not raise tuple_minimum on the margin alone.

token_tuple_vote.reason: measured below baseline (75.4% vs 78.4%) and needs 13+ examples per sense against a deck median of 4

calibration.reason: trained on dictionary gold, applied to real speech; 58% of the old deck read low and the bands were meaningless

domain_weight.reason: 92.6% in isolation but flat then negative on top of the existing score; baseline is already 90.9% where domains compete
